BiblicalUsage: hădar turns up where the Bible says to honour, to magnify. In Daniel 4:34, the text says "and I praised and honoured him that liveth for ever." In Daniel 4:37, the text says "Now I Nebuchadnezzar praise and extol and honour the King of heaven."
TheologicalSignificance: hădar convinces me that worship is not a performance but a response — we answer what God has done with what we are. That is why I keep this word in mind when I read those passages — it carries more than its size suggests.
RelatedEvents: Nebuchadnezzar's Humbling; Belshazzar's Handwriting on the Wall
